notes: Kinto 0.19.0 - built from release commit e87dbc4 on kinto-0.6-native-lens. Rolls up the pie work: Sensu-style selection and rim scrubbing, the two-window overlay, the edge handle editor, slice and ring-layout editors, the Opal hub, honest device controls with app, system and shortcut slices, the transparent wheel, and Favorites/Recents app rings. Settings is reorganized with search and a dedicated Edge controls screen, and Scenes are retired. New in this release: timed navigation wedges (Back, Home, Recents, Previous, Assistant), a practice mode, editable named rings, slice-selection preview with capacity and confirmation, directional flick and haptic preferences across both wheels, and settings motion polish.
